run_fit_normalizers_cli: run the fit_normalizers script with --config and --out-path to fit dataset normalizers from a config yaml
run_fit_norms_with_linref: run fit_norms with a linear reference file to compute element-wise energy references before fitting normalizers
fit_normalizers_from_config: fit dataset mean and std normalizers using a config dict and save them to a checkpoint file
create_element_references: create element references from a fitted linear reference file for use in normalizer computation
save_normalizers_checkpoint: save fitted normalizers to a normalizers.pt checkpoint file using save_checkpoint utility
